subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving related rates, optimization, or area/accumulation, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student solves a realistic scenario (engineering design, economics, physics) requiring an appropriate calculus tool
exercise.pictorial: Student diagrams the scenario before setting up the calculus expression
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world calculus application word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot identify which calculus tool (related rates, optimization, or definite integral) the problem calls for

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
